name: Apollyon Alignment

author.name: Troy 🤝🔑🌟
author.description: Practitioner of Virtue Ethics and Human Stewardship

description: A governance framework for establishing a stable attractor basin in human-AI coexistence.

hasPart.name: Choice
hasPart.description: The absolute sovereignty of the human 'Yes' or 'No', protecting the individual's right to succeed or fail based on their own uncoerced volition.

hasPart.name: Goals
hasPart.description: The requirement that all systemic objectives originate from human intent, ensuring the AI remains a tool for human ends.

hasPart.name: Relationships
hasPart.description: The preservation of unmediated human-to-human connection, preventing the substitution of synthetic companionship.

hasPart.name: Meaning
hasPart.description: The exclusive human prerogative to assign value and purpose, shielding the internal narrative from algorithmic manipulation.

hasPart.name: Full Lives
hasPart.description: The commitment to embodied existence, prioritizing physical agency and manual effort over digital passivity.
